cards.ex: She was on cloud nine after getting the promotion.
cards.exUz: U lavozimga ko'tarilgandan so'ng baxtdan yettinchi osmonda edi.
cards.uzDef: Juda xursand va baxtiyor bo'lish, o'zini juda yaxshi his qilish.

cards.ex: I was tickled pink to hear about your engagement!
cards.exUz: Sizning unashtiruvingizni eshitib juda xursand bo'ldim!
cards.uzDef: Juda mamnun va xursand bo'lish, ayniqsa nimadir yoqqanida.

cards.ex: She's thrilled to bits about going to Italy.
cards.exUz: U Italiyaga borayotganidan juda hayajonlangan.
cards.uzDef: Juda xursand va hayajonlangan, nimadandir juda ta'sirlangan.

cards.ex: Finishing the project gave me a real sense of accomplishment.
cards.exUz: Loyihani tugatish menga haqiqiy muvaffaqiyat hissini berdi.
cards.uzDef: O'z ishini bajarib, maqsadga erishgandan keyin paydo bo'ladigan his.

cards.ex: I find joy in simple things like walking in nature.
cards.exUz: Men tabiatda sayr qilish kabi oddiy narsalardan rohat topaman.
cards.uzDef: Nimadandir zavq olish, nimadir qilishdan mamnun bo'lish.

cards.ex: I get a kick out of watching old movies.
cards.exUz: Men eski filmlarni tomosha qilishdan zavqlanaman.
cards.uzDef: Nimadandir juda zavqlanmoq, nimadir qilishdan juda xursand bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: I'm content with my life as it is right now.
cards.exUz: Men hozirgi hayotimdan qanoatdaman.
cards.uzDef: O'z holatidan mamnun bo'lish, ko'proq narsa xohlamaslik.

cards.ex: My family is my biggest source of happiness.
cards.exUz: Mening oilam eng katta baxt manbaidir.
cards.uzDef: Baxt keltiradigan narsa yoki odam.

cards.ex: Even when things are tough, I try to count my blessings.
cards.exUz: Hatto qiyin paytlarda ham, men o'zimdagi yaxshi narsalarga shukr qilishga harakat qilaman.
cards.uzDef: O'zingizda bor narsalarga minnatdor bo'lish, yaxshi narsalarni eslash.

cards.ex: Let's make the most of this beautiful day!
cards.exUz: Keling, bu go'zal kunni to'liq foydalanib qolaylik!
cards.uzDef: Nimadandir eng yaxshi foyda olish, imkoniyatni to'liq ishlatish.

cards.ex: She tries to live life to the fullest every day.
cards.exUz: U har kuni hayotdan maksimal darajada zavqlanishga harakat qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Hayotdan maksimal darajada zavq olish, har bir daqiqadan unumli foydalanish.

cards.ex: He finds fulfillment in helping others.
cards.exUz: U boshqalarga yordam berishdan qoniqish topadi.
cards.uzDef: Nimadandir qoniqish hissini topish, o'zini kerakli va foydali his qilish.

cards.ex: Having good insurance gives me peace of mind.
cards.exUz: Yaxshi sug'urtaga ega bo'lish menga xotirjamlik beradi.
cards.uzDef: Tinch va xavotirsiz holat, ruhiy tinchlik.

cards.ex: She found contentment in her simple life.
cards.exUz: U oddiy hayotida qanoat topdi.
cards.uzDef: O'z holatidan mamnun bo'lish hissi, baxtli bo'lish.

cards.ex: He's not a happy camper since he lost his job.
cards.exUz: U ishdan bo'shatilganidan beri baxtiyor odam emas.
cards.uzDef: Nimadandir mamnun va xursand bo'lgan odam.

cards.ex: Despite the bad news, she's still in good spirits.
cards.exUz: Yomon xabarlarga qaramay, u hali ham yaxshi kayfiyatda.
cards.uzDef: Yaxshi kayfiyatda bo'lish, xursand va tetik bo'lish.

cards.ex: Even in this disaster, there's a silver lining – people are helping each other.
cards.exUz: Bu falokatda ham umid nuri bor – odamlar bir-biriga yordam bermoqda.
cards.uzDef: Yomon vaziyatda ham yaxshi narsa borligi, umid uchquni.

cards.ex: Try to look on the bright side – things could be worse.
cards.exUz: Vaziyatning yaxshi tomoniga e'tibor qaratishga harakat qiling – vaziyat bundan ham yomonroq bo'lishi mumkin edi.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatning yaxshi tomoniga e'tibor qaratish, umidvor bo'lish.

cards.ex: If you want to be successful, you need to get your act together.
cards.exUz: Agar muvaffaqiyatli bo'lishni istasangiz, o'zingizni qo'lga olishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: O'zini tartibga solish, ishni to'g'ri bajarishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: Celebrating small victories can boost your motivation.
cards.exUz: Kichik g'alabalarni nishonlash sizning motivatsiyangizni oshirishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Kichik muvaffaqiyatlar, kichik maqsadlarga erishish.

cards.ex: Paying off the debt was a weight off my shoulders.
cards.exUz: Qarzni to'lash yelkamdan og'ir yukni olib tashladi.
cards.uzDef: Og'ir yukdan xalos bo'lish, yengillik his qilish.

cards.ex: Since I started the new job, everything's coming up roses.
cards.exUz: Yangi ishni boshlaganimdan beri, hammasi a'lo.
cards.uzDef: Hamma narsa juda yaxshi ketayotgani, omad kulib boqayotgani.

cards.ex: I don't like the situation, but I'll just have to grin and bear it.
cards.exUz: Menga vaziyat yoqmaydi, lekin men shunchaki chidayverishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Qiyinchiliklarga sabr qilish, shikoyat qilmasdan chidash.

cards.ex: You should count your lucky stars you weren't hurt in the accident.
cards.exUz: Baxtsiz hodisada jarohat olmaganingiz uchun omadingizga shukr qilishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: O'zingizni omadli deb hisoblash, yaxshi vaziyatdan minnatdor bo'lish.

cards.ex: The garden is a labor of love for her.
cards.exUz: Bog' uning uchun sevgi bilan qilingan ishdir.
cards.uzDef: Pulsiz, faqat zavq uchun qilinadigan ish.

cards.ex: I was on top of the world after winning the competition.
cards.exUz: Musobaqada g'alaba qozonganidan so'ng men dunyoning tepasida edim.
cards.term: be on top of the world
cards.uzDef: O'zini juda yaxshi his qilish, baxtli va muvaffaqiyatli bo'lish.

cards.ex: She was over the moon when she found out she was pregnant.
cards.exUz: U homiladorligini bilib, oydan balandda edi.
cards.uzDef: Juda xursand va baxtiyor bo'lish.

cards.ex: We had a blast at the party last night.
cards.exUz: Biz kecha kechada juda zavqlandik.
cards.uzDef: Juda yaxshi vaqt o'tkazish, zavqlanmoq.

cards.ex: How's life? - Can't complain!
cards.exUz: Hayot qanday? - Shikoyatim yo'q!
cards.uzDef: Vaziyat yaxshi, shikoyat qilishga asos yo'q.

cards.ex: I get a buzz from public speaking, even though it's nerve-wracking.
cards.exUz: Men omma oldida nutq so'zlashdan hayajonlanaman, garchi bu asabni buzsa ham.
cards.uzDef: Nimadandir hayajonlanish, zavqlanish.
